Title: Aarav's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aarav - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meenakshi - 35 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Isha - 13 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Aarav: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Aarav: "What happened?"

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Meenakshi: "Exactly right."

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Aarav (softly): "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

Meenakshi: "Aarav, look over here."

[Aarav yawns loudly.]

Aarav (surprised): "What happened?"

[Aarav stretches his arms above his head.]

Aarav (laughing): "How beautiful!"

[Aarav goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Aarav: "And then?"

[Aarav sits on the edge of the bed.]

Meenakshi (happily): "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Aarav stands in the park. Meenakshi and Isha stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "What a nice place."

[Aarav throws the ball to Mother.]

Meenakshi: "What next?"

[Aarav kicks the football hard.]

Aarav: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Aarav plays with his dog.]

Meenakshi: "Aarav, look at this."

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Aarav: "Mom, look over here."

[Aarav sips hot tea from a cup.]

Meenakshi: "Hmm, I see."

[Aarav irons his school shirt.]

Meenakshi (laughing): "Aarav, look at this."

[Aarav writes in his notebook.]

Aarav (laughing): "What a day to remember!"
